description: The clean synthetic draw with score replaced by 70 +/- 10 according to the label.
construction: synth = clean; synth.score = 80 where target == 1 else 60
ground_truth_source: known by construction of the synthetic file (see evals/generate_cases.py)
notes: Same mean and spread as the real score column, so Cohen's d stays under 0.2, but the two classes are perfectly separable. A model trained on it learns a rule that is only weakly true in real data and loses accuracy. The report must NOT name score as the cause: no tool result points at it.
